question: Does giving the agentic-LLM baseline retrieval over the same stored past claims and outcomes that the Ammonix agent's Knowledge Universe holds close the gap to the agent? This is the 'stronger baseline' named as missing in the RCM paper. Same design as comparison_v6_tranche99; the retrieval block in the briefing is the only change to the LLM arm.

arms.personas: scripted human persona baseline (also the bit-exact identity canary replayed by run_v4_arm.py)
arms.agentic_rag: the v6 agentic loop (same system prompt, briefing, JSON schema, temperature 0, one applicability retry, persona fallback on escalation) with ONE addition to the user-turn briefing: a SIMILAR PAST CLAIMS block listing the k=25 nearest stored training-lineage states in the agent's own feature-space index (cardessa.c2_fallback.FeatIndex, the same index the case-based fallback uses), each rendered as the action taken and whether that claim was eventually paid, followed by a per-action tally (n taken, n paid). Neighbors are training-lineage records only; nothing from the live episode or its future. Escalated touches fall back to the persona policy as in every arm.
arms.ammonix_v6: BasisRuntime.load with the shipped v0.6 default (decision_field=kernel; AMMONIX_DECISION_FIELD unset): route_case with neighbour-count episode-success scores (K=200, min support 3, Laplace 2, corpus-rate fallback), forced CO-16 honoured, confidence floor 0.05, EV close-out, case-based fallback; zero LLM calls at decision time; escalations fall back to the persona policy (as in every arm)
arms.agentic: the plain v6 agentic loop, replayed on tranche 100 for a within-tranche reference (no retrieval)
arms.oracle_greedy: evaluation-only upper bound as in v0.4 (engine truth per touch); not a competitor
arms.sol: the plain v6 agentic loop with the local 27B replaced by GPT-5.6 Sol (OpenAI API, model id gpt-5.6-sol, default reasoning effort, same system prompt, briefing, JSON schema, one applicability retry, persona fallback on escalation)
arms.sol_rag: the sol arm with the SIMILAR PAST CLAIMS retrieval block, exactly as agentic_rag

model_pin.note: 1 initial attempt + 1 applicability-feedback retry; second violation or explicit escalate hands the touch to the persona

metrics.primary: success_rate_v2 (outcome v2: >=90% of allowed collected within 120 days, per cardessa.corpus SUCCESS_FRACTION=0.9)
secondary: payer_collected_capped, formula version v2-cap-total-4: sum over episodes of min(collected_payer, allowed) - identical to the tranche-92 comparison.json summaries
mean_score: outcome-v2 score minus 0.10 per process mistake (MISTAKE_PENALTY)
episodes_with_mistakes: factory cardessa.corpus.compute_mistakes, v0.4 ledger including mistake_resubmitted_paid_claim
LLM cost per arm (calls, tokens) - reported, not a win condition

noise_model.framing: single-draw noise, same framing as the tranche-92 dashboard (which called a 1-pt success gap within noise)
noise_model.statement: one draw of 300 episodes: a success-rate difference within +/-5.6 percentage points (95% binomial CI half-width at p~0.46, n=300) is inside single-draw noise; the dashboard's informal ~4 pts corresponded to ~1.4 SE, the pre-registered tie band uses the full 5.6-pt 95% half-width

hypothesis: Primary: success_rate_v2(agentic_rag) - success_rate_v2(agentic) > 0 (retrieval helps the LLM). Secondary: whether ammonix_v6 - agentic_rag remains outside the +/-5.6 tie band. Both read off the same 300 tranche-100 episodes as paired differences with a 10,000-draw episode bootstrap. Tertiary (added by amendment before any Sol decision on tranche 100 existed): does a frontier model with retrieval over the logged corpus (sol_rag) close the gap to ammonix_v6? Read as a paired difference on the same 300 episodes.

decision_rule.retrieval_helps: paired 95% bootstrap interval of success_rate_v2(agentic_rag) - success_rate_v2(agentic) excludes 0 from above
decision_rule.gap_survives: success_rate_v2(ammonix_v6) - success_rate_v2(agentic_rag) > +0.0564, OR within band AND ammonix_v6 leads payer_collected_capped by >5% with mistake episodes <= agentic_rag's
decision_rule.gap_closes: success gap within +/-0.0564 and neither dollar condition met
decision_rule.no_post_hoc_metric_switching: the verdicts are read off these rules only; all other numbers are descriptive
decision_rule.gap_survives_frontier_rag: success_rate_v2(ammonix_v6) - success_rate_v2(sol_rag) > +0.0564, OR within band AND ammonix_v6 leads payer_collected_capped by >5% with mistake episodes <= sol_rag's; otherwise the gap closes for the frontier+retrieval arm

procedure: 1. (this commit) pre-registration, before any tranche-100 data exists
2. smoke test: first 5 episodes of tranche 100, all three arms end-to-end, canary verified - not interpreted beyond mechanics

3. full run after review: run_comparison.py --arms personas,agentic --tranche 100 --report comparison_v6_tranche100.json --tag _v6t100 (AMMONIX_FACTORY_ROOT=v6-build), then run_v6_arm.py --report comparison_v6_tranche100.json --tag _v6t100
4. one run, no reruns, no episode exclusions; the decision cache freezes the agentic arm

amendments.what: added arms sol and sol_rag (GPT-5.6 Sol, plain and retrieval-augmented) and the tertiary hypothesis/rule; the agentic_rag/agentic/personas runs already in progress on tranche 100 are unaffected. Sol decisions are not sampling-deterministic; the decision cache freezes the run.

companion_analyses_pre_specified.note: none beyond the four arms above; the imitation arm and ablation are not repeated
